minutes.summary: The team reviewed the library booking pilot, discussing success criteria, metrics, budget caps, and a launch timeline. They decided to proceed with a conditional two-branch pilot on Friday, October 9th, covering Harbor and Cedar branches with 40 total invited adult patrons. Success metrics include a 10-day observation window, at least 30 completed patron bookings, zero double bookings, and a maximum of 5% needing help with the basic flow. The pilot has a $200 budget cap for the first month, and invitations will only be sent upon receiving written privacy approval and completing staff tests.
decisions: Launch the invited two-branch pilot on Friday, October 9th, starting with Harbor at 10:00 and Cedar at noon, conditional on written privacy approval and passing staff tests.
Approve a $200 budget cap for the first month of the two-branch pilot.
Adopt success criteria of 10 days of observation, at least 30 completed patron bookings, zero double bookings, and at most 5% needing help with basic booking.
Schedule a review of the pilot results for Monday, October 19th, at 10:00 AM.
Pause new invitations if support tickets exceed five per day, while keeping existing reservations active unless data integrity issues arise.
